scope: Specific baseline scanner claims and concrete reachable callers; not a repository-wide clean-security verdict. Fresh runs have separate evidence.

findings.message: Data from an [untrusted source](1) will not be auto-escaped because it was converted to template.HTML
findings.rationale: `template.HTML` intentionally treats administrator-authored HTML as markup. SARIF entry is `auth_admin.go:307` preview HTML/action URL. Route is `accessAdminSession`; response is JSON. The administrator UI separately uses `sanitizeMailHtml` in `ui/admin/src/auth/mailPreview.ts`, rebuilding nodes and removing scripts/event handlers. No unauthenticated cross-user admin XSS was established. Dynamic URL interpolation nevertheless created extra elements and corrupted a link under a reproducible preview test; contextual rendering now keeps data separate from markup.
findings.resolution: Contextual rendering and malformed-context validation added; no unauthenticated or cross-user admin XSS established.

findings.message: Email content may contain [untrusted input](1).
findings.rationale: Constructor rejects CR/LF in From and parses its mailbox. Send rejects CR/LF in To/Subject and parses To before encoding. Attachments reject CR/LF in filename/content type. `smtp.Client.Data` returns a textproto DotWriter, which dot-stuffs body terminators. Added local SMTP fixture regression for all header controls and a forged DATA terminator. Arbitrary body text is intended message content.
findings.resolution: No security bypass established for this scanner trace; retain explicit scope and boundary.

findings.message: Incorrect conversion of an integer with architecture-dependent bit size from [strconv.Atoi](1) to a lower bit size type int32 without an upper bound check.
findings.rationale: `len(code)==6` bounds Atoi's result far inside int32. However signed `+70624` is accepted as the valid `070624` OTP. Strict six ASCII digit parsing now rejects noncanonical aliases without changing legitimate OTPs. This is not a demonstrated second-factor bypass or reduced secret search space.
findings.resolution: Six-byte input already prevents int32 overflow. Separate signed-code alias accepted by Atoi was reproduced and fixed with six ASCII digits.

findings.message: Incorrect conversion of a signed 64-bit integer from [strconv.ParseInt](1) to a lower bit size type int32 without an upper bound check.
findings.rationale: V5Descriptor.Matches intentionally compares BOTH low and high 32-bit halves of each int64 catalog version, ANDing their constant-time comparisons. Added a high-bit-only mismatch regression; truncation does not discard the high half.
findings.resolution: No security bypass established for this scanner trace; retain explicit scope and boundary.

findings.message: This log entry depends on a [user-provided value](1).
findings.rationale: SARIF mixes request hook events whose Kind includes a supplied schema operation with an unrelated application start hook invocation. `beginApplicationStart` constructs fixed HookAppBoot/HookAppServe kinds; Run/Start return those specific hook errors. Example uses text log.Fatal; operator or trusted hook error text is not guaranteed one line, so this is not a universal endorsement of arbitrary log sinks.

findings.message: This string may still contain [<script](1), which may cause an HTML element injection vulnerability.
findings.rationale: htmlText is a lossy text summary, not an HTML sanitizer. Its inspected callers render React text children/attributes, not raw HTML. Five DOM rendering regressions cover malicious tags/entities in cells and relation options; a future raw-HTML caller must not reuse this helper as a sanitizer.
findings.resolution: Documented text-only boundary and added renderer regressions.

findings.message: The [URL](1) of this request depends on a [user-provided value](2).
findings.rationale: A crafted ?api URL selected the destination of credentials entered into the public JavaScript example. Login and SSE both used that destination. The attacker must convince a user to enter credentials on the crafted example link. Both sites share one root cause; separate theft of a legitimate-server-issued bearer token was not established.
findings.resolution: Removed query-selected API origin; deployment-owned configuration and cross-origin migration example. Four Node regressions fail before/pass after; real browser contract added.
